After installing Modeler 14.1 64-bit client and Statistics 32-bit client on a 64-bit operating system, Modeler cannot find the Statistics install. Nor will any of the Statistics function within Modeler. The user will receive the error "Please run the Statistics License Utility"


RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
 

Having a 64-bit install of Modeler and a 32-bit installation of Statistics is not a supported configuration by IBM SPSS. In order to use the SPSS Statistics nodes from within Modeler, you will need to install the 64-bit version of Statistics. HSM-enabled DataPower appliances support the export of private keys using the crypto-export command. For key export to work, various conditions must be met: 

 * HSMs must be initialized and in the same key sharing domain on exporting and importing machines 
 * The private key in question must be marked exportable at keygen time (see keygen's exportable option) 
 * HSMs on exporting and importing machines must share internal key-wrapping keys (see hsm-clone-kwk command). A key-wrapping key is a key that encrypts another key. Each HSM has a special key inside of it, the key-wrapping key, that is used to encrypt exported private keys (and to decrypt imported private keys).

Finally, before the crypto-export crypto-import sequence, the key-wrapping keys must be synchronized using the hsm-clone-kwk command. This command must be run four times: once on the source HSM appliance (with the key-wrapping key you are copying), once on the destination HSM appliance, once again on the source HSM appliance, and once again on the destination HSM appliance. Each time the command is run, it will need the output file from the previous step (as the input to the current step) which must be moved manually (usually with the copy command). Once all of this has been done, then private keys may move from system to system with crypto-export and crypto-import.
